ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage with 15% high-intensity (white/cream) distal patches localized at lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central and proximal low-intensity region; irregular high-intensity patch on the distal-lateral portion of the left lobe; smaller high-intensity patch on the superior-distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth approximately 30% of visible fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; left lobe features a significant macro-scale indentation (tissue loss) on the lateral margin; right lobe shows finer, more regular serrated peaks coinciding with barnacle attachment points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve sweeping outward from the median notch; left lobe trajectory is interrupted by a sharp, irregular indentation on the far lateral edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white/tan clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the upper-most distal vertices of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear tracks visible; at least three parallel horizontal rake marks on the medial-right lobe surface; single diagonal abrasion on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation on the left fluke's lateral edge suggesting significant tissue loss; dense calcified barnacle clusters along the superior trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly ragged, non-uniform profile of the left lobe tip compared to the more continuous right lobe sweep.
